name: popsicle
headline: Hotnews: Newsletter-to-Video Generator
short_description: This Python toolkit creates a dynamic system, extracting content from newsletters & generating unique videos. It then publishes automatically on a YouTube channel and Steemit social media
author: stakewalker

sections.overview:
Hotnews is a Python toolkit designed to streamline newsletter-to-video conversion. It extracts newsletter content, generates engaging YouTube music videos with creative thumbnails, and automatically publishes them to YouTube channels. The system integrates lofi music, uses MoviePy for video generation and PIL for thumbnail creation, and leverages Selenium for YouTube publishing. This toolkit is ideal for content creators, marketers, and newsletter authors looking to repurpose written content into visual video format without manual production work.
Repurpose weekly newsletters into YouTube video content
Automate video generation for newsletter publishers
Create consistent lofi music video thumbnails at scale
Publish newsletter summaries as YouTube shorts or long-form videos
